entries.text: Someone tabbing through the footer with a screen reader hits three links in a row that announce only 'link' — the icons inside are hidden from them, so nothing says Facebook, X or YouTube. The same three nameless stops repeat on every page — home, apply, sign-in, status — so the only way to learn where one goes is to activate it and leave the page.

The pale grey timestamp on white, at about 2.8 to 1, washes out for someone with low vision or reading in daylight on a phone: the line 'Last updated October 3, 2026' is visibly there but not readable, so a person checking whether their claim status is current cannot tell how fresh the page is. It sits in the footer of all five pages, so there is nowhere else to find that date.
